connector.name: Aegis by getaegis
connector.registryDescription: Credential isolation for AI agents. Inject secrets at the network boundary.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cli. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the getaegis account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AEGIS_MASTER_KEY
env.description: Master encryption key for the credential vault

env.name: AEGIS_SALT
env.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte salt for key derivation (generated by aegis init)

env.name: AEGIS_DATA_DIR
env.description: Directory for vault databases and registry (default: .aegis/)

env.name: AEGIS_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error (default: info)

env.name: AEGIS_LOG_FORMAT
env.description: Log output format: json or pretty (default: json)

env.name: AEGIS_REQUIRE_AGENT_AUTH
env.description: Require agent authentication on every request (true/false, default: false)

env.name: AEGIS_POLICY_MODE
env.description: Policy enforcement mode: enforce, dry-run, or off (default: enforce)

env.name: AEGIS_METRICS
env.description: Enable Prometheus metrics endpoint (true/false, default: true)
